Title: 'K, what's the story of Brass Knuckles?

Messages.Author: Azel
Messages.Body:
This may be a baseless assumption, but from my google searching on how to
play this card from this newsgroup, the accepted function of this card is
that it provides +1 strength for one strike in combat. I always thought this
was the case even from the first time I got one in a Sabbat booster. I
always thought the "once each combat" prevented multiple strikes with them
(with just one copy).

Brass Knuckles

Type: Equipment

Melee Weapon.

Strength+1 damage each strike. This weapon is only usable once each combat.

Rarity: Sabbat:C SW:C/PT/PV CE:C

But I've always been baflled by the other words on the card "each strike."
It just seems so... conflicting. So I was wondering am I seeing this card
wrong? Is it once each combat as in restricted to a single round? a single
strike (like i think)? Some other thing I'm overlooking? Or is there some
really cool background story to this card? Honestly, I'd be happiest if
there is some really cool/funny background story. Something involving design
team celebrating with one too many drinks at the finale of making the Sabbat
set and overlooked a typo or something. I dunno. Anyone know why this card
is written like this?

Messages.Author: The Nosferatu Stuff
Messages.Body:
"Azel" <opao...@comcast.net> wrote in message
news:S_ednSPWvrh...@comcast.com...



Its worded that way because it has to be. The minion only gets the extra
damage, when striking.
without the "each strike" it would say "strength +1 damage" which could mean
all the time, +1 strength on bleed actions, +1 strength on using your
bastard sword, or maybe it would mean you only get the +1 damage once ever,
who knows when! its just to clarify when you get the bonus.
--
The Nosferatu Stuff

Messages.Author: Azel
Messages.Body:
but, see, that still leaves me baffled. because why don't they just write
the card as,

strike: strength +1. only usable once each combat.

for examples of precedent see:

Garrote

Type: Equipment

Cost: 1 pool

Melee weapon.

Strike: strength damage, only usable at close range. If the opposing vampire
goes into torpor during the strike resolution step of this strike and the
bearer remains ready, the bearer may burn this card to burn the opposing
vampire. This is not considered diablerie.

Rarity: FN:C/PA

Flash Grenade

Type: Equipment

Weapon.

Strike: combat ends. If the opposing minion is a vampire, he or she is
tapped and does not untap as normal on his or her next untap phase. If the
bearer is a vampire and the grenade is used at close range, the bearer is
also tapped and does not untap as normal on his or her next untap phase.
Burn this weapon after use.

Rarity: Gehenna:C

(this is gonna be a long post, providing evidence for your leisure) As you
can see, the [strike: xyz] manner of writing exists. But I did notice
something interesting - even during Sabbat set - most of the cards that
follow this Brass Knuckles pattern came from this set. Yet they could have
been following precedent. I shall show Examples:

Brass Knuckles

Type: Equipment

Melee Weapon.

Strength+1 damage each strike. This weapon is only usable once each combat.

Rarity: Sabbat:C SW:C/PT/PV CE:C

Gas-Powered Chainsaw

Type: Equipment

Cost: 1 pool

Melee Weapon.

3 damage each strike. This weapon is only usable once each combat.

Rarity: Sabbat:C SW:C/PB CE:C

Now here is where I find the earliest example of this wording. From the
Jyhad set:

Sawed-Off Shotgun

Type: Equipment

Cost: 2 pool

Weapon, gun.

3R damage each strike. This weapon is only usable once each combat.

Rarity: Jyhad:C VTES:C SW:PB CE:PB

The closest wording from the Jyhad set to this card is:

Chainsaw

Type: Equipment

Cost: 2 pool

Weapon.

3 damage as a strike, usable only once each combat.

Rarity: Jyhad:U2

But here's some fun. One could say that this is an issue of updating wording
on card texts; considering Garrote paved the way for new wording it's just a
matter of time to fix that. But notice as Garrote came out during FN that
BK, GPC, and SOS all came out in the following set CE without the change.
Now I don't know if there's expense reasons to not change the text, but this
was the set that had the drastic border change, let alone that each new set
has to have its own new symbol at the top.

There might be a reason behind all this and I'd like to know because I'm
curious. I think there might be an interesting story hiding behind. So,
unless there is some rules thing I'm overlooking, does anyone have behind
the scenes pieces of this puzzle? So far it's making a real cool mystery...

Messages.Author: Azel
Messages.Body:
my Sabbat set Brass Knuckles and Gas Powered Chainsaw are worded differently
than described by the modern version of CE. They actually make a bit more
sense to me in saying "the minion with this equipment can inflict [xyz] as a
strike once each combat." heh, wondered why they changed it (besides the
obvious hand damage stuff when applicable).

the plot thickens!
